body:
DUELS panel's Play button queues with a duel's live match_token via encodeQueue's new optional 33-byte form -- the same purely-additive wire shape core/protocol.c already decodes, a second real consumer of the Phase 2 extension. DeadweightClient gained queue(sameDeck?, matchToken?) + getState(). Live-verified end to end: real headless Chrome (CDP-driven) loaded the real compiled web/dist/main.js through the real ws-tcp-bridge.js against a real dw_server, clicked the actual rendered Play button, paired with a real dw_client CLI partner on the same token -- confirmed from both sides' logs. tsc strict clean. Commit e16dbfa. WOTAN (Phase 3c) still needs its own wiring.

⚓ ☃
title: Duel Phase 3b: browser client Play button queues with match_token (S537)
